// Witness for `no_hand_written_classification_impl_outside_command_error`.
//
// A commented impl is no witness: impl ClassifyExitCode for Commented {}

impl ClassifyExitCode for Probe {
    fn classify(&self) -> u8 { 70 }
}

impl ocx_exit::ClassifyErrorKind for Probe {
    fn kind(&self) -> u8 { 1 }
}

macro_rules! hidden {
    () => {
        impl ClassifyExitCode for Hidden {
            fn classify(&self) -> u8 { 70 }
        }
    };
}

// `CommandError` is excused in `ocx_cli/src/app.rs` only.
impl ClassifyExitCode for CommandError {
    fn classify(&self) -> u8 { 70 }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod fixtures {
    impl ClassifyExitCode for TestOnly {
        fn classify(&self) -> u8 { 70 }
    }
}
